column1: # AQL Language Specification: String operations (concat split trim
# contains indexof replace changecase upper lower repeat pad escape match)
# String words are forward-eligible. Most take the subject string first;
# several accept a trailing options Map (e.g. trim {chars:…}, changecase
# {style:…}). concat reduces a List of values to one String.
# §1  concat — join a list of values into one String
# §3  trim — drop surrounding whitespace, or a custom char set
